concept: Lines 2px wide with round joins, an end dot with a surface ring, direct end labels and a crosshair tooltip.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a line chart with thick smoothed curves, dots on every point and a second y axis
default_to_avoid.kind: line chart, trend chart, area chart
default_to_avoid.why_not: smoothing invents values, dots on every point are noise and a second axis misleads

derivation.consequence: the scene supplies the hue; the system owns no hue of its own, only white at opacities and one ink, and colour appears only where it states a status or marks a diagram
derivation.form: marks carry the data palette, which belongs to the content like a scene or a photo, and the frame around them owns no hue (D-031)

derivation.consequence: status is spoken in text as well as shown in colour
derivation.form: every value is also in direct labels, a tooltip and a table view, so nothing is read by colour alone

derivation.consequence: secondary text keeps the lowest opacity that still measured as passing; text halos count only where WCAG allows them
derivation.form: every word on the chart is in a text tone, never in a series colour

variants.reason: A follows the mark specs and labels ends (dataviz). B invents values. C is the first chart mistake.

line.why: each line is 2px in its series colour with round joins

area.why: a single series may carry a faint wash of its own colour

dot.why: the end dot or the dot at the crosshair carries a surface ring

live.why: a hidden live line says the value in focus so a screen reader hears what the tooltip shows

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the lines keep their data colours so series stay apart
